coverage.name: Boulder County
limitations: County-level questions on the compiled sample ballot, all read in full and excluded: Boulder County Ballot Issue 1A (2.579-mill levy for early childhood care and education; not housing); Boulder County Ballot Questions 200/201 (initiated, expand Board of County Commissioners to five members and election method; governance); Ballot Issues 6A (Eldorado Springs PID wastewater debt), 6B (Sombrero Ranch PID road mill levy), 6C (Summerlin PID road mill levy) — not housing.

No 2026 county question extends or modifies Boulder County's existing affordable-housing sales and use tax; the county's own Ballot Issues page lists only 1A, 6A, 6B, 6C plus the initiated commissioner-expansion measure.

Also on the county ballot but not county measures: Proposed Municipality of Niwot Questions/Issues 300-306 (incorporation, charter commission, sales/property/marijuana taxes, revenue retention, road debt; none earmarked for housing), Front Range Passenger Rail District 7A, Allenspark FPD 7C, Timberline FPD 7B — none housing. Niwot is not a row in this file.

No separate list/IGA of participating political subdivisions for the Nov 3, 2026 election was posted on bouldercounty.gov as of 2026-09-26 (checked /elections/, /elections/information/, /elections/ballot-information/; the 2026 TABOR notice and Official Notice of Election were not yet posted — probed URLs returned 404). The county's 'Compiled Sample Ballot' (all ballot content for all coordinating entities, marked 'Not an official ballot') was used as the participation list.
The compiled sample ballot is not the TABOR notice; the TABOR notice was not posted as of 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Boulder (city)
limitations: Excluded by owner decision (2026-09-26). City of Boulder Ballot Issue 2J, RESIDENTIAL VACANCY EXCISE TAX (TABOR), exact text: "SHALL THE CITY OF BOULDER TAXES BE INCREASED $6,000,000 ANNUALLY (WHICH AMOUNT REPRESENTS ESTIMATED REVENUES IN 2028, THE FIRST FULL FISCAL YEAR OF COLLECTION), AND BY SUCH AMOUNTS RAISED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER, BY IMPOSING A $4,000 TAX ON VACANT HOMES THAT ARE OCCUPIED FOR 183 DAYS OR LESS PER YEAR, WITH SUCH AMOUNT NEVER FALLING BELOW $4,000 BUT INCREASING ANNUALLY IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE DENVER-AURORA-LAKEWOOD CONSUMER PRICE INDEX UP TO, BUT NEVER EXCEEDING $7,000, WITH THE REVENUE FROM SUCH TAX TO BE USED FOR THE PURPOSE OF SUPPORTING CITY SERVICES, INCLUDING: POLICE AND FIRE PROTECTION; PARKS AND RECREATION; TRANSPORTATION AND MAINTENANCE; AND OTHER GENERAL SERVICES IMPORTANT TO THE QUALITY OF LIFE IN THE CITY; AND SHALL THE REVENUES FROM SUCH TAXES AND ANY RELATED EARNINGS BE COLLECTED, RETAINED, AND SPENT AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE WITHOUT LIMITATION AND AN EXCEPTION TO THE REVENUE AND SPENDING LIMITS OF ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION?" Reason: the tax is levied on vacant residential property (a housing-occupancy tax), but the question earmarks revenue for general city services, not housing.

Excluded: Ballot Issue 2K (Recreation and Safety Bond, up to $400,000,000 GO debt for recreation centers, fire stations, public safety and municipal buildings; not housing); Ballot Question 2L (charter collective bargaining for firefighters); Ballot Question 2M (charter debt limit to three percent of actual value; general debt capacity, not housing).
City clerk's 2026 ballot measures page (bouldercolorado.gov) matches the sample ballot text for 2J, 2K, 2M.

No separate list/IGA of participating political subdivisions for the Nov 3, 2026 election was posted on bouldercounty.gov as of 2026-09-26 (checked /elections/, /elections/information/, /elections/ballot-information/; the 2026 TABOR notice and Official Notice of Election were not yet posted — probed URLs returned 404). The county's 'Compiled Sample Ballot' (all ballot content for all coordinating entities, marked 'Not an official ballot') was used as the participation list.

coverage.name: Longmont (city)
limitations: Excluded: City of Longmont Ballot Issue 3A (2.44-mill levy plus 0.33% sales and use tax for police/fire public safety; not housing); Ballot Question 3C (ranked choice voting); Ballot Question 3D (council election cycles).

Excluded by owner decision (2026-09-26): disposal of city-owned land, not zoning or land-use regulation. City of Longmont Ballot Question 3B, Charter Amendment to Protect Open Space Lands, exact text: "Shall the City of Longmont Home Rule Charter be amended by revising section 13.2 to add open space to lands that cannot be sold or conveyed without voter approval, with exceptions for public roads, utilities, life-essential infrastructure, open space operations, and the sale or conveyance of structures on such lands?"

City clerk page states Council referred four items (3A-3D) to the Nov 3, 2026 coordinated ballot, matching the county compiled sample ballot. Longmont also extends into Weld County; the Weld County ballot was not reviewed (Longmont's city measures are citywide and appear on the Boulder County compiled ballot).
